findings.current: The incitement, the speech, and the declaration were over.
findings.defect: The draft presents three separate things ending, whereas the source describes one act as simultaneously incitement, a speech, and a declaration.
findings.rationale: The constructions 선동이자 and 연설이며 identify multiple aspects of the same act rather than items in a list.
findings.replacement: The incitement—at once a speech and a declaration—was over.

findings.current:
The back of a hero who had always seemed so strong was this beautiful.

The back of him.
findings.defect: The rendering is unnatural English and blunts the repeated 뒷모습 punchline contrasting the hero’s public appearance with what is seen after he turns away.
findings.rationale: The repetition of 뒷모습 is deliberate and should land as a short corrective punchline rather than the unidiomatic phrase “the back of him.”
findings.replacement:
A hero who had always seemed so strong could look this beautiful from behind.

From behind, that is.
findings.source:
언제나 강해 보였던 영웅의 뒷모습은 이토록 아름다웠다.

뒷모습은.

findings.current: A sudden heat reached me from far away, making me feel as though my entire body were standing on end.
findings.defect: The literal construction makes Michael’s entire body seem to stand upright rather than conveying the physical sensation of bristling or getting goose bumps.
findings.rationale: 전신이 곤두설 것 같았다 describes a whole-body bristling reaction, naturally expressed in English through hair standing on end.
findings.replacement: The sudden heat reaching me from so far away made every hair on my body stand on end.
findings.source: 갑작스럽게 저 멀리서 전해지던 열기에 전신이 곤두설 것 같았지.

findings.current: According to the watchers’ report, the area was shaken not long after the Skeleton King left the hotel.
findings.defect: The draft changes the source title “Stone King” to “Skeleton King” and omits that he was the first to leave.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly says 스톤 킹 and 먼저; changing a proper title and dropping the sequence marker alters both identification and event order.
findings.replacement: According to the watchers’ report, the Stone King left the hotel first, and the surrounding area shook not long afterward.
findings.source: 감시원들의 보고에 따르면, 스톤 킹이 먼저 호텔을 빠져나가고 얼마 지나지 않아 인근이 뒤흔들렸다고 합니다.

findings.defect: The declarative wording loses Michael’s repetition of the report as newly received information.
findings.rationale: The ending -다라 reflects Michael turning the reported detail over questioningly before asking for additional information.
findings.replacement: “The monster left first, you say? What else?”

findings.current: Even if he was remembered as one of the heroes of the Great Cataclysm, there had been many walls standing in his way.
findings.defect: “Even if” makes Michael’s status as a remembered hero sound hypothetical, although the source treats it as an established fact and contrasts it with the obstacles he still faced.
findings.rationale: Here -었어도 is concessive—“although” or “even though”—not a conditional casting doubt on his reputation.
findings.replacement: Though he was remembered as one of the heroes of the Great Cataclysm, many walls still stood in his way.
findings.source: 대격변의 영웅 중 한 사람으로 기억되었어도 그를 가로막는 벽은 많았다.

findings.current: The scenery of the spacious room, the various pieces of furniture and equipment placed here and there, and finally the person himself all changed.
findings.defect: “The person himself” implies that Michael physically transforms, while the source describes the person shown within the mirror changing along with the reflected surroundings.
findings.rationale: The preceding sentence locates everything within the rippling mirror, and the resulting image contains darkness and the robed Prophet; the transformation is of the mirror’s contents, not Michael’s body.
findings.replacement: The spacious room changed, along with the furniture and fixtures scattered throughout it. Finally, the person reflected there changed as well.
findings.source: 넓은 방 안의 풍경도, 군데군데 놓인 각종 가구와 집기도. 마지막으로 사람도 변했다.

findings.current: Hope that someone would protect them and the people precious to them from those monsters.
findings.defect: The draft changes the singular 저 괴물 into plural “those monsters,” altering the specific threat the public hopes to be protected from.
findings.rationale: 저 괴물 is explicitly singular and demonstrative; both the number and specificity must be retained.
findings.replacement: Hope that someone would protect them and their loved ones from that monster.
findings.source: 누군가가 저 괴물로부터 자신들을, 소중한 사람들을 지켜 주리라는 희망.

summary: The draft contains several fidelity errors affecting a proper title, a confirmed historical fact, the mirror’s mechanism, and the number of monsters referenced, plus localized losses of nuance and naturalness.
